Resort-to-Resort

Visiting multiple properties? We provide seamless transfers between resort locations.

Spa & Golf Additions

Combine resort stays with off-property spa visits or golf rounds at courses throughout Scottsdale.

Departure Service

Perfectly timed pickup for departing flights with luggage handling and relaxed journey to the airport.

Pricing

  • Airport to resort, Luxury SUV (up to 6): $225 one way
  • Airport to resort, Executive Black Sprinter (up to 14): $295 one way
  • Resort to resort: priced as a transfer at the same flat prices
  • Full-day resort service: hourly, from $125 an hour in the Luxury SUV with a 4-hour minimum

A transfer is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off; longer transfers are priced from the drive with the empty return included. There are no sedans in our fleet. Prices are before 8% Arizona sales tax. Every rate is on the pricing page.
